solutions.question: 1(c)
solutions.latex:
Using the sine rule,

$$\begin{aligned}\dfrac{\sin x^\circ}{14} &= \dfrac{\sin 13^\circ 25'}{9.2}\\ \sin x^\circ &= \dfrac{14\sin 13^\circ 25'}{9.2} = 0.353\ldots\\ x^\circ &= 20.676\ldots^\circ \text{ or } 180^\circ-20.676\ldots^\circ = 159.32\ldots^\circ\end{aligned}$$

But $x^\circ$ is obtuse, so $x^\circ = 159^\circ 19'$ (to the nearest minute).
solutions.marks_breakdown: Teacher's note: this question should have been out of 3. -1 if the obtuse angle is not given, but no penalty if rounded to the nearest degree.

solutions.question: 2(b)
solutions.latex:
$$\begin{aligned}\dfrac{3}{16} &= \dfrac{x}{432}\quad \text{where } x \text{ is the total tagged}\\ \therefore x &= \dfrac{432\times 3}{16} = 81\end{aligned}$$

81 kestrels tagged.

solutions.question: 3(a)

1800 mL over 10 hours, so 1800 mL over 600 min, which is 3 mL/min.

Answer: (D) 90

solutions.question: 3(b)
solutions.latex:
100 m in 9.58 seconds, so 0.1 km in 9.58 s, so $\dfrac{0.1}{9.58}$ km in 1 s.

$$\dfrac{0.1}{9.58}\times 3600 \text{ km in 1 h}$$

$$\text{speed} = 37.578\ldots \approx 37.6 \text{ km/h (to 1 dp)}$$

solutions.question: 4(b)
solutions.latex: $$\begin{aligned}p^2 &= b^2+c^2-2bc\cos P\\ BC^2 &= 48^2+37^2-2\times 48\times 37\times\cos 75^\circ\\ &= 2753.67\ldots\\ BC &= 52.475\ldots\\ &= 52 \text{ m (to nearest m)}\end{aligned}$$
solutions.edited_from_original: The guidelines print 'BC = 52.475... = 53 m (to nearest m)'; 52.475 rounds to 52 m, so the final line was corrected to 52 m.

solutions.question: 5(b)
solutions.latex:
flour : sugar $= 3 : 2$.

2 cups of flour make 25 cookies, so cups of flour for 60 cookies $= 2\times 2.4 = 4.8$.

$$3:2 \ \to\ (3:2)\times 1.6 = 4.8 : x$$

Sugar $= 2\times 1.6 = 3.2$ cups.

solutions.question: 7(a)
solutions.latex:
$$38 \text{ mm}\times 150 = 5700 \text{ mm} = 5.7 \text{ m},\qquad 44 \text{ mm}\times 150 = 6600 \text{ mm} = 6.6 \text{ m}$$

$$\text{Area} = 5.7\times 6.6 = 37.62 \text{ m}^2$$

solutions.question: 7(b)
solutions.latex:
$\angle LAB = 28^\circ$, $\angle ABL = 134^\circ$, so

$$\angle ALB = 180^\circ - (28^\circ + 134^\circ) = 18^\circ$$

Using the sine rule,

$$\dfrac{LB}{\sin 28^\circ} = \dfrac{500}{\sin 18^\circ}$$

$$LB = \dfrac{500\sin 28^\circ}{\sin 18^\circ} = 759.62\ldots \approx 760 \text{ m (to nearest m)}$$
From the data, $r = 0.8819\ldots = 0.882$ (to 3 sf), as in part (ii).
